use_when.text: Keep button labels clear, concise, and action-oriented.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

use_when.text: Use the appropriate size based on the context and layout.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

use_when.text: Maintain consistent button styles and hierarchy across the product.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

use_when.text: Use the correct usage variant for the intended interaction and context.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

use_when.text: Provide clear interaction states, including hover, pressed, focus, and disabled.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

use_when.text: Keep sufficient spacing between buttons to make actions easy to identify and interact with.
use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use multiple Primary buttons together when one clear primary action is sufficient.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use a Primary button for secondary or less important actions.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use Secondary buttons when the action is the main focus of the screen.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t mix different button sizes within the same action group without a clear purpose.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use buttons for navigation when a link is more appropriate.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use overly long button labels that make the button difficult to scan or fit within the layout.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use button styles inconsistently across similar actions or screens.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t remove or alter the button’s required interaction states, such as hover, pressed, focus, or disabled.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Don’t, text I17:826;2406:416;17:819)

primary.text: Use Primary buttons for the most important action on a screen.
primary.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

secondary.text: Use Secondary buttons for supporting or alternative actions.
secondary.source: Figma 17:826 (Buttons Doc Frame › Do, text I17:826;2406:461;17:822)

placement.text: CardItem’s WithSlotContent story renders it in CardItem’s bottom Slot (`children`).

a11y.text: Renders a native <button>, with type="button" by default.
state="disable" sets the native disabled attribute.
The icons are aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false"; the visible text is buttonLabel.
